explanation: V0.2 Slice 1 (employee contracts): the state digest's encoding became dreamteam.state/v2. It added the employment registry (identity, lifecycle stage, employed dates, contract terms) and each hourly employee's weekly guaranteed-pay counters.

V0.2 Slice 2 (hire and terminate): the encoding is now dreamteam.state/v3. It adds each employee's hire and termination records and first productive day, growable employee sets in slot staffing (no 64-employee limit), practice-caused displacement records and counters, the recruiting, severance and severance-payable accounts, each order's tolerance anchor and placements, and each appointment's confirmation flag, no-show lead basis and placement. The session record schema is dreamteam.session/v2, which the run digest names.

Outcomes are unchanged: without a V0.2 action no employee is hired or terminated, every scenario's inferred contract is at or below its roster (so no guarantee is posted) and the V0.2 accounts hold nothing and are not listed. Patient flow, reports, every ledger entry, the log, actions, the evaluation baseline and all result values are identical; only the state digest, and the run digests derived from it, differ.

The references stay byte-for-byte as their engine wrote them; this manifest records each changed field's old (historical) and new (this build's) value, and a comparison under it requires both exactly.

V0.2 Slice 3 (set_roster) keeps dreamteam.state/v3: roster versions are encoded only when an employee has one, so every state above encodes as before. One observable message changed: a batch mixing a V0.1 action with V0.2 staffing actions is refused (mixed_batch) with a message naming the V0.2 actions, now 'hire, terminate, set_roster'. established-staffing.actions.json has such a batch, so in established-seed1-60d-staffing.json (written by 0.2.0-dev.2) the action record's digest, and the run digest derived from it, differ; the log, ledger and state digests and every outcome are identical. Replaying a 0.2.0-dev.2 session file applies its batches with that build's action set and reproduces its message and every digest exactly.

0.2.0-dev.4 (the dynamic staffing benchmark) changes no engine behaviour: established-seed1-60d-roster.json (written by 0.2.0-dev.3) is reproduced in every field, digests included, so it is listed with no changed field. A 0.2.0-dev.3 session file replays with every digest verified (batch mode v0.2_slice3).

0.2.0-dev.5 (V0.2 Slice 4, set_reading_allocation) changes no outcome without the new action: a radiologist's allocation versions are encoded only when present, so every reference is reproduced as under 0.2.0-dev.4, and the refusal of a batch mixing a V0.1 action with V0.2 actions keeps its recorded message unless the batch holds a set_reading_allocation. 0.2.0-dev.3 and 0.2.0-dev.4 session files replay with every digest verified (batch mode v0.2_slice3).

0.2.0-dev.6 (pre-Slice 5 remediation) changes outcomes only where its fixes apply: a radiologist's reading blocks that touch (allocation 100%) no longer end reading at the first boundary, a read running through other duties into the next block owes the borrowed time, and a reading allocation stays in force at least 14 days before the next change. No reference reaches any of these (their allocations leave other-duty time longer than any read, and their allocation changes are at least 14 days apart), so every reference, established-seed1-60d-allocation.json (written by 0.2.0-dev.5) included, is reproduced in every field and listed with no changed field. Because the fixes do change outcomes elsewhere, a 0.2.0-dev.5 session file replays in batch mode v0.2_slice4: this build's action set under dev.5's reading and allocation rules, with every digest verified; earlier builds' files replay under those rules too.

0.2.0-dev.7 (V0.2 Slice 5A, the remote reading engine) changes no outcome without a teleradiology contract, and no action can create one yet: the remote reading state is encoded only when a contract exists, and a study's reader keeps its encoding. Every reference is reproduced in every field as under 0.2.0-dev.6. A 0.2.0-dev.6 session file replays in batch mode v0.2_dev6: this build's action set and rules, with every digest verified.

Every reference is reproduced in every field as under 0.2.0-dev.7. Session files of 0.2.0-dev.5 to dev.7 replay with their action set, in which contract_teleradiology was an unknown action (batch modes v0.2_slice4, v0.2_dev6 and v0.2_dev7), with every digest verified.
